blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jeepney driver Tatay Elmer, who was hospitalized after participating in a nationwide transport strike last September, has passed away, his social media handler confirmed in a post on Wednesday. “Our hearts are heavy as we let you know that Elmer Miralles Cordero also known by many as “Tatay Elmer” has passed away peacefully on October 7, 2026,” his page handler said in his Facebook account at around 7:45 p.m. His family also confirmed in a social media post.
